The '''DH-17 short carbine''', otherwise known as the '''DH17 Short Carbine''', or '''DH-17 Snubnose''', was a subnosed variant of the [[DH-17 blaster carbine/Legends|DH-17 blaster carbine]] that was used at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The DH17 Short Carbine was a weapon in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It could be crafted by players of the [[:w:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader profession]].
